# Reporting a vulnerability

We encourage responsible disclosure of security issues. If you find something suspicious, we
appreciate you telling us.

## How to report

This repo has GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting turned on. Do not use public issues if you
have found a vulnerability.
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/kartverket/komreg-parameterfil-poc/security/advisories/new)

If you cannot use GitHub's reporting flow, contact Kartverket's security team at
<cybersikkerhet@kartverket.no>.
